prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with bright red hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a light purple crop top and white shorts"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09", "P10", "P11", "P12"].

message.content: {"matches":["P08"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P08 is the only person with bright red hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a light purple crop top and white shorts. All other individuals either have different hair color (e.g., blonde, brown, black), different hairstyles (e.g., loose, low ponytail, bangs), or different clothing (e.g., purple pants, white long sleeves, different top styles)."}

parsed.reason: P08 is the only person with bright red hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a light purple crop top and white shorts.
